$comment: Random life events (about 1 in 3 months). cost [min,max] for expenses or gain [min,max] for windfalls, scaled by inflation. category matches an insurance category. requires: vehicle | pet | property | car | business | job. difficulty: entry | advanced (omit = both).

events.title: Flat tire!
events.text: Your bike got a flat tire.
events.tip: Small surprises are why we keep an emergency fund.

events.title: Car trouble
events.text: Your car needs new brakes.
events.tip: Cars cost more than their price: fuel, insurance and repairs add up.

events.title: Fender bender
events.text: Someone backed into your car in a parking lot.
events.tip: This is exactly what vehicle insurance is for.

events.title: Boat engine trouble
events.text: Your boat's engine needs a rebuild.

events.title: Doctor visit
events.text: You caught the flu and visited the doctor.
events.tip: Health insurance turns big scary bills into smaller ones.

events.title: Broken arm!
events.text: You slipped at the skate park and broke your arm.
events.tip: With good health insurance you'd only pay the deductible.

events.title: Dentist
events.text: A cavity needs a filling.

events.title: Vet visit
events.text: Your pet ate something it shouldn't have!
events.tip: Pets need an emergency fund too.

events.title: Leaky pipe
events.text: A pipe burst in your home.
events.tip: Owners pay for repairs; renters usually don't.

events.title: Roof repair
events.text: A storm damaged your roof.

events.title: Cracked phone
events.text: You dropped your phone and the screen cracked.

events.title: Laptop died
events.text: Your laptop stopped working right before a big project.

events.title: Lost wallet
events.text: You lost some cash on the bus.
events.tip: Money in the bank is safer than cash in your pocket.

events.title: Birthday gift
events.text: Your best friend's birthday is coming, you bought a gift.
events.tip: Gifts are planned spending. Budget for them!

events.title: School trip
events.text: Your class is going on a trip to the science museum.

events.title: Expenses went up
events.text: Prices for everyday things went up this month (inflation!).
events.tip: Inflation slowly raises prices. Investing helps you keep up.

events.title: Parking ticket
events.text: Oops, you parked in the wrong spot.

events.title: Business equipment broke
events.text: An important machine at your business broke.
events.tip: Businesses need cash reserves for repairs too.

events.title: Forgot a form
events.text: You forgot to report some side income and owe a little extra tax.

events.title: Gift from Grandma
events.text: Grandma sent you a birthday card with money inside!

events.title: Work bonus!
events.text: Your boss gave you a bonus for great work.

events.title: Found coins
events.text: You found coins in the couch cushions!

events.title: You won a contest!
events.text: Your science project won second place.

events.title: Rebate
events.text: A store sent you a rebate check for something you bought.

events.title: Garage sale
events.text: You sold old toys and books at a garage sale.

events.title: Viral review!
events.text: A famous food blogger loved your business. Extra customers this month!
